in_marathi.name: Sreeja
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sreeja हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name 'Sreeja' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sri', which means 'wealth'. The prefix 'ja' denotes 'born'. Thus, the name 'Sreeja' signifies 'Goddess of Wealth, born'. This name is associated with prosperity, abundance, and good fortune in Hindu tradition.
